40: After a police chase with an otherworldly being, a New York City cop is recruited as an agent in a top-secret organization established to monitor and police alien activity on Earth: the Men in Black. Protecting the Earth from the scum of the universe.

In a country where anybody can become President, anybody just did.

Their innocence. Their heritage. Their lives.

Declared illegitimate aged 3. Tried for treason aged 21. Crowned Queen aged 25.

John Sayles invites you to return to the scene of the crime.

Bond is back. Back in action. Back with excitement.

You'll never believe how close we came.

A storm of fear and fury in the sizzling Florida Keys!

The trap is set. The game is on.

Watch out Aliens... here comes Derek!

No computer graphics. No stunt doubles. No wires.

Same Land. Same God. Different Dreams.

Leave your expectations at the door

A love story. More or less.

It's not about the money. It's about the money.

Everyone has a wild side. Even a legend.

Love is fickle! Love is blind! She runs 'round the country...with him behind!

He's got to face a gunfight once more to live up to his legend once more. To win just one more time.

5416: After a childhood prank by his brother Angus causes Henry to develop a phobia of sheep, he must step up to the onslaught of a genetically-mutated man-eating flock with the help of his friend and a young environmentalist.
There are over 40 million sheep in New Zealand, and they're pissed off!

Soon Emmi and Ali are forced to confront their own insecurities about their future.
5928: Life for the residents of a tower block begins to run out of control.

Solving a crime can be dirty work

From The Pages Of The Beloved Best Seller... A Motion Picture To Delight All The World!

One wrong move and it's all out war.

Bring The Little Woman...Maybe She'll Die Laughing!

Abraracourcix / le marchand de bœufs / Caius Bonus (voice)

This is one case that's going to be settled out of court.

A BANDIT WHO BECAME A LEGEND! Roaring Story of Mexico’s Tiger on a White Horse!

Angry and embarrassed, the boys find their naive ideas about power being challenged.

If you go down to the woods today.

Fantômas / Fandor / Sir Walter Brown / Giuseppe Luigi

Romance! Adventure!...as wild as the RAGING SEAS!

Getting to the top means taking down the competition.

Outnumbered - unarmed - unprepared - they stunned the world with their incredible victory!

We fall apart to come together.

In a life of crime, no one can be trusted... Not even your friend.

THE SOMETIMES VIOLENT STORY OF A DRIFTIN' COWHAND!
18728: A bored bisexual millionaire picks up a young destitute street artist and whisks her away to her villa in Saint Tropez. They meet a dashing local architect and both fall for him, setting in motion a ménage à trois of deception and betrayal.

Three wise girls who barred no holds and bit in the clinches.

It's a game of two pubs!

The more he gets into trouble, the more he gets under her skin!

The seeds of love grow like the seeds of hate.

21288: When Gino meets racing driver Bénédicte, it's love at first sight. But Gino has a secret. The kind of secret that can endanger their lives.

How far would you go for a lost love?

There were 3 conditions to the 5 million dollar inheritance, and they had to be bathed twice a week.
22824: When a capable dancer is provoked by the evil design of his employer, naturally he will be out to prove his mettle.

23592: Diagnosed with Tourette Syndrome at 15, John Davidson navigates his way against the odds through troubled teenage years and into adulthood, finding inspiration in the kindness of others to discover his true purpose in life.
I blink. I twitch. I jump. I click. I whistle. I shout.
23848: A tailor gains special powers after being struck by lightning but must take down an unexpected foe if he is to become the superhero his hometown in Kerala needs.
24104: A student must overcome bullies and hardships, both academic and romantic, in order to win his college's coveted Student of the Year trophy.
24360: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.
24616: Tormented by a past life, garbage man Clean attempts a life of quiet redemption. But when his good intentions mark him a target of a local crime boss, Clean is forced to reconcile with the violence of his past.
24872: A space princess is thrust out of her sheltered life into a galactic quest to save her bounty hunter ex-girlfriend from the straight white maliens.
She'll save her ex. Or die crying.

25384: The movie Saskin (Silly) is about a young guy Mehmet, who falls in love with a girl who happens to comment about perfect love on a radio show and follows her to a holiday resort where she possibly work.
25640: After witnessing his parents' brutal murder on Christmas Eve, Billy transforms into a Killer Santa, delivering a yearly spree of calculated, chilling violence. This year, his blood-soaked mission collides with love, as a young woman challenges him to confront his darkness.

26152: A small town girl Siya, who decides to fight for justice,, fighting against all odds and starts a movement against the vicious system.
26408: When a cop's crooked past comes back to get him, can he do the right thing, or will he succumb to the threats of his dangerous connections?
Once a bad cop, always a bad cop.
26664: A chronicle biopic of the 22-year career of soccer star Roberto Baggio, including depictions of his difficult debut as a player, his deep rifts with some of his coaches, his triumph over injuries and personal discovery of Buddism.
26920: A single mother battles her past demons to safeguard her child's future, facing daunting challenges to shield her daughter from imminent danger.
27176: Set in the port town of Dover in the South-East of England, Mary Hussain suddenly finds herself a widow following the unexpected death of her husband. A day after the burial, she discovers he has a secret just twenty-one miles across the English Channel in Calais.
27432: A busty Batwoman enlists her beauteous bevy of Batgirls to help her regain a mad scientist's invention–an atom bomb made from a hearing aid–before costumed ne'er-do-well Rat Fink can glom onto it for his own purposes.
27688: A small time crook and a newly-orphaned teenage boy team up to perform a string of robberies.
How far can one man go?
27944: An aspiring actor and a struggling DJ team up to pursue the ladies they love and a diamond that rightfully belongs to their oversexed dog.
28200: Two rival college students begin an unconventional online romance when they pretend to be each other's crushes on social media.
28456: Simhadri, a loyal servant in a landlord's house, leads a secret life as Singamalai, a powerful leader in the state of Kerala.
28712: Nani's brother and his friends are his world. But he shares a love-hate relationship with his sister-in-law Jyothi. What happens when Shiva threatens his family, is what 'MCA' is all about.

However, there is a legend that if a pure human heart is freely offered to a demon, it can become a mortal and experience true life.  Sequel of Painted Skin (2008).
29224: Raghavan, a farmer, raises his brother, Vijayakumar, and gives him an education. However, when he grows up and gets married to a rich woman, Vijayakumaran conveniently forgets about his brother.
29480: TILT is a love story set against the backdrop of the changing political and social environment in Europe in the late 80's and early 90's. Can this love survive the challenges of emigration, a violent homeland and immoral social atmosphere thanks to a gang of adventurous friends?
29736: Returning from a personal loss and a six months suspension, Archana Prasad, an assistant commissioner of police is assigned with the responsibility to solve a tricky double murder case.
29992: Living in an Ankara shantytown, Mehmet plays the clarinet at a nightclub to support his family. When their home is sold to a contractor by his brother-in-law, the gap between Mehmet’s dreams and reality significantly grows.
30248: Identical twin brothers live separate lives for years without seeing each other. They have grown up in very different circumstances. One is a gangster who spreads terror around him, while the other is a modest bank clerk.
30504: Newlyweds Cory and Sarah Morgan take Cory's 7-year-old son Liam up to the country for some much needed family time. 30760: A young, idealistic director arrives in a village to make a picture set during the Great Bengal Famine. It’s a film that he hopes will reveal the problems and privations still current in rural India.

A simple story about love no matter how you spell it
31784: A vain businessman puts strains on his happy marriage to a rich, beautiful socialite by allowing himself to be seduced by a former girlfriend.
I was married to a man other women pursued!

Piece by Piece...Atom by Atom...Humans Invisibly Teleported Through Time and Space!!!

The funniest couple ever is born.

Stay Awake. Breathe. Your Life Depends On It.

Can democracy be built on forgetting?
